name: effort-advisor
description: Suggests a reasoning effort level before, during and after each task; shows tips without changing settings.

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: How sure the advisor must be before it shows a tip (0.3 to 0.95). Higher means fewer tips.

show_toast.title: Show toasts
show_toast.description: Also show each tip briefly as a toast. The band above the prompt shows it either way.

mid_task_tips.title: Mid-task tips
mid_task_tips.description: Suggest a different level when a task turns into debugging or into routine edits.

turn_end_tips.title: Turn-end tips
turn_end_tips.description: At the end of a turn, suggest a level for the likely next step.

ultracode_hints.title: Ultracode hints
ultracode_hints.description: For whole-codebase audits, also mention Ultracode (multi-agent, uses much more). Turn off if your Claude Code has no Ultracode.
